public_rationale: The sentence has two parts. The first, that Marcus has warned about this since August 2023, is about his own writing, and his own posts cannot be used to show he was right. The second, that the economics of generative AI 'don't make much sense', is a judgment. It names no metric, company, threshold, or period. Large losses and huge planned spending (Altman spoke of 'trillions' for data centers) could be read as either irrational or as normal early-stage investment. Picking a test such as 'labs are unprofitable' would put words in his mouth, so this claim cannot fairly be scored true or false.
limitations: A narrower claim, such as 'OpenAI loses money', would be checkable from financial reports, but that is not what he wrote.
